items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: they were all gentlemen except Johnny Young said he came up the hard way.

ctx.x: Not too well, just a few of them. I remember when the singer Al Hibbler went to Jay McShann. He was probably, all of the guys in there knew me personally. Mm-hmm. But, I've forgotten quite a number of those guys unless they come up and refresh my memory and then I can recognize them.

Well, yeah. Well, the thing I'm getting at, you know, like Lunsford men, they were all gentlemen except Johnny Young said he came up the hard way. Right. And, he was very self-conscious when he went in with the band.
Well, the reason for that is most all of Jim Lunsford's men were college men. Yeah. Or had had some time in college.
